description: A manually @Component-wired class that merges a scope must add the generated merged super type; the rejection message embeds the component's own name, so a renamed component proves the name interpolation.

sources:
package com.example

import me.tatarka.inject.annotations.Component
import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.AppScope
import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.MergeComponent

@Component
@MergeComponent(AppScope::class)
abstract class AppComponent

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=AppComponent is annotated with @MergeComponent and @Component. It's required to add AppComponentMerged as super type to AppComponent. If you don't want to add the super manually, then you must remove the @Component annotation.
